spawn.transcription_note: Photo 2 second-word bit 7 is visually ambiguous between 00000003 and 00000083. Both full transcriptions and decodes are retained. Photo 1 has 00000003, so both alternatives give exactly the same certain intersection.

interpretation: The upper interval 0x8cea0000-0x8cfa0000 is a 1 MiB candidate untouched in both captures, not a permanent reservation. The common 256 KiB lower interval is too small for the 384 KiB runtime lease.
The larger interval is above the measured combined stage end 0x8ce8dd08. Static hook lifetime and allocator placement proofs are still required.
Spawn reproduces poor streaming without a virtual VMU, so VMU work cannot be the sole explanation.
RAM marking runs before launch and scanning at return, not every frame. Its changed initial memory contents may still affect reads, so a no-pattern structural control is needed.
RET/FN/CMD/LBA/COUNT/DEST are last-service fields; they do not measure stream rate, underruns or retry counts.
